Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-J at 3655 W Wrightwood

                                   ORDINANCE                  ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ 0 - 2 . ^


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Single-Unit (Detached House)
District, as shown on Map 7-J in the area bounded by:

West Wrightwood Avenue; a line 79 feet east of and parallel to North Lawndale
Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Wrightwood Avenue; and a line
39 feet east of and parallel to North Lawndale Avenue.


to those of RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.




Common Address of Property: 3655 West Wrightwood Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60647
                                  NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                      F O R T H E PROPOSED ZONING MAP AMENDMENT

                           AT 3655 W E S T W R I G H T W O O D A V E N U E

        The Applicadon is for a Zoning Map Amendment from RS-3 Single-Unit (Detached House)
District to Rl'-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District. The Applicant intends to
construct a four (4) dwelling unit building with four (4) off-street garage parking spaces. The footprint
of the building shall approximately be 71'6" by 32 feet in size. The bmlding height shall be 38 feet, as
defined by City Code.

LOT AREA: 40ft x 125ft = 5000 sq feet

FLOOR AREA RATIO: 1.2 FAR

B U I L D I N G AREA: 6000 square feet

M I N I M U M L O T AREA per D W E L L I N G U N I T : 1250

OFF-STREET PARKING: Four (4) garage spaces

FRONT SETBACK: 15 feet

REAR SETBACK: 38 feet 6 inches

SIDE SETBACK: Four (4) feet east and four (4) feet west side yards

BUILDING HEIGHT:             38 feet
